abilities.critical_failure: The creature’s frightened condition is reduced by 1.
abilities.critical_success: The creature takes 2d4 mental damage and its frightened condition increases by 1, to a maximum of frightened 3.
abilities.effect: The spirits manifest with a terrible wailing. Each creature in the area must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or be frightened 1 (or frightened 2 on a critical failure). Frightened creatures are immobilized for as long as they remain frightened. The haunt then rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Manifest

traits.name: Auditory
traits.text: Auditory actions and effects rely on sound. An action with the auditory trait can be successfully performed only if the creature using the action can speak or otherwise produce the required sounds. A spell or effect with the auditory trait has its effect only if the target can hear it. This applies only to sound-based parts of the effect, as determined by the GM. This is different from a sonic effect, which still affects targets who can’t hear it (such as deaf targets) as long as the effect itself makes sound.

traits.name: Emotion
traits.text: This effect alters a creature’s emotions. Effects with this trait always have the mental trait as well. Creatures with special training or that have mechanical or artificial intelligence are immune to emotion effects.

traits.name: Fear
traits.text: Fear effects evoke the emotion of fear. Effects with this trait always have the mental and emotion traits as well.

traits.name: Mental
traits.text: A mental effect can alter the target’s mind. It has no effect on an object or a mindless creature.

abilities.trigger: A creature the spirits knew in life enters the haunted area

hazard.description: The spirits of community members linger on after their tragic deaths.
hazard.disable: DC 20 Diplomacy (untrained) to Request that the spirits leave or DC 18 Religion (trained) to exorcise the spirits
hazard.name: Haunting Echoes
hazard.reset: The haunt falls silent for 24 hours once all frightened creatures die or reduce their frightened condition’s value to 0. During this time, a creature that isn’t frightened can exorcise the spirits with a DC 18 Religion check, permanently destroying the haunt.
hazard.routine: (1 action; auditory, emotion, fear, mental) The haunt attempts an Intimidation check with a +11 modifier against the Will DC of each frightened creature as it bombards them with the voices of their dead loved ones.

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
